items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: my father's friend, Mr. Gibson, who was the stage manager for Talk on the York Show

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, I know that. A dollar and a half, a dollar and a half a week. Yeah. He introduced me to red beans and rice at the Chinamans for a nickel. I swear. China's eating in the world. And they sold, they sold two, two pork chops for a dime. Well, they used to go in Martins, in the alley, and have a big piece of roast beef there. They'd give you one slice of bread cutting and put that roast beef on it. And they had free lunch, free lunch, a bunch of cheese and stuff and stuff. And there comes along a fellow…
When Gus Wick opened up, we had a makeup box.
